capabilities.instructions: RIVE UI PRO MAX — awwwards-grade Rive recipes. Call rive_doctor first to confirm the Rive desktop app is open, then run recipes like rive_scaffold_overlay, rive_signature_reveal, rive_holo_shimmer. rive_presets returns easing/palette tokens; rive_raw_call is the bridge escape hatch.

tools.name: rive_scaffold_overlay
tools.description: Scaffold awwwards overlay — Transparent artboard + bound ViewModel + a glass side-rail with header & stat rows. The premium starting point.

palette.description: Palette id (oracle-vault, midnight-aurora, noir-ember, porcelain-ink, synth-violet, sage-luxe)

side.description: right | left — which edge the rail docks to

tools.name: rive_glass_panel
tools.description: Glass panel — Frosted glass layout panel (low-alpha fill + radius). Use for cards, chips, HUD blocks.

parent.description: Parent layout id (blank = attach to active artboard)

tools.name: rive_staggered_cascade
tools.description: Staggered cascade — Children of a parent rise + fade in, offset by a step. Returns a one-shot timeline id.

parent.description: Parent layout id whose children cascade

tools.name: rive_signature_reveal
tools.description: Signature reveal — Hero entrance: target slides from an edge + fades, children cascade. The moment that wins the look.

tools.name: rive_breathe_loop
tools.description: Breathe loop — Subtle infinite scale+opacity breathe so an element feels alive. Ambient layer material.

tools.name: rive_gold_foil_sweep
tools.description: Gold-foil sweep — A bright specular bar rakes across a target (one-shot). Reads as foil/holo catch-light.

target.description: Object to sweep over (its id is reused for sizing reference)

tools.name: rive_vignette
tools.description: Cinematic vignette — Low-alpha feathered dark frame for depth + focus. Stays transparent-safe for OBS.

tools.name: rive_marquee
tools.description: Marquee loop — Continuous horizontal translate loop for a strip (ticker, sponsor bar). Linear, seamless.

tools.name: rive_wire_reveal_sm
tools.description: Wire reveal state machine — Build the proven Flow (Idle→Reveal→Display→Exit, trigger-driven + exit-time) + always-on Ambient layer over your timelines.

revealTriggerVmProp.description: VM trigger property id for Idle→Reveal

tools.name: rive_holo_shimmer
tools.description: Holographic shimmer (Luau) — Iridescent 4-stop gradient that sweeps a target forever on an additive blend. Returns the Luau Node + attach steps.

tools.name: rive_count_up
tools.description: Number count-up (Luau) — A Node that eases a price/number 0→value each frame and writes a currency-formatted string to a bound text prop. Returns the Luau source + steps.

tools.name: rive_sheen
tools.description: Sheen light-pass — A quick diagonal white light-pass across a surface — tactile, reflective. One-shot band + timeline.

tools.name: rive_depth_shadow
tools.description: Depth shadow — A soft, background-tinted feathered shadow offset behind a card for real elevation. Never pure black.

tools.name: rive_kinetic_type
tools.description: Kinetic type — Headline group rises + overshoots into place (elastic). Animates the container, never font-size.

tools.name: rive_rect
tools.description: Rectangle primitive — Place a rectangle with fill/stroke/feather — the building block under glass cards, bars, gilds, masks.

tools.name: rive_divider
tools.description: Hairline divider — A 1–2px hairline for section separators or a gold edge-gild. Horizontal or vertical.

tools.name: rive_focus_ring
tools.description: Focus ring — A 2px accent outline at an offset around a box + a fade-in timeline to drive from a focused boolean. Never remove focus.

tools.name: rive_particle_assemble
tools.description: Particle assemble — N shard rects converge from scattered offsets into a tight cluster with an elastic settle. The high-drama hero coalesce.

tools.name: rive_state_driven_theme
tools.description: State-driven theme — Creates a Theme ViewModel of color tokens + one instance per palette. Bind fills/runs to these → re-theme everything from one source (the #1 PRO-MAX move).

themes.description: Comma-separated palette ids → one instance each

tools.name: rive_scramble_text
tools.description: Scramble text (Luau) — A Node that resolves a target string left-to-right out of random glyphs over a duration. Returns the Luau source + steps.

tools.name: rive_magnetic_hover
tools.description: Magnetic hover (Luau) — A Node that reads pointer events and writes a lerped offset to two VM numbers (springs back on exit). Bind your element x/y to them. Returns the Luau source.

tools.name: rive_parallax_depth
tools.description: Parallax depth — Creates scroll/scrollSmooth number VM props + a Luau lerp Node + an amplitude Converter so layers travel at different speeds against one scroll source.

tools.name: rive_doctor
tools.description: Check the Rive desktop bridge connection and list the open artboards.

tools.name: rive_raw_call
tools.description: Escape hatch: call a raw Rive bridge tool (e.g. animation_editor) with arbitrary arguments.

tools.name: rive_presets
tools.description: Return the PRO-MAX design tokens: named awwwards easings (cubic-bezier) and curated palettes.

tools.name: rive_docs
tools.description: Read the bundled references — design DNA, anti-generic laws, recipe catalog, the raw Rive bridge API, AND the official Rive Luau scripting docs (protocols/scaffolds, drawing API Path/Paint/Gradient/Renderer/Vec2D, data-binding, script inputs, pointer events). Call with no topic to LIST every doc; pass a slug (e.g. "scripting/protocols", "scripting/drawing-api", "design-dna", "bridge-cheatsheet") to read one. Use this BEFORE writing any Luau (holo-shimmer, count-up, custom effects).

topic.description: Doc slug, e.g. scripting/protocols. Omit to list all.

    },
    "dramatic-inout": {
      "cubic": [
        0.76,

    },
    "dramatic-inout-x": {
      "cubic": [
        0.87,

        0.13,
        1
      ],

    },
    "snap-settle": {
      "cubic": [

      ],

    },

tools.description: Gold-foil sweep — A bright specular bar rakes across a target (one-shot). Reads as foil/holo catch-light.

target.description: Object to sweep over (its id is reused for sizing reference)

tools.name: rive_vignette
tools.description: Cinematic vignette — Low-alpha feathered dark frame for depth + focus. Stays transparent-safe for OBS.

tools.name: rive_marquee
tools.description: Marquee loop — Continuous horizontal translate loop for a strip (ticker, sponsor bar). Linear, seamless.

tools.name: rive_wire_reveal_sm
tools.description: Wire reveal state machine — Build the proven Flow (Idle→Reveal→Display→Exit, trigger-driven + exit-time) + always-on Ambient layer over your timelines.

revealTriggerVmProp.description: VM trigger property id for Idle→Reveal

tools.name: rive_holo_shimmer
tools.description: Holographic shimmer (Luau) — Iridescent 4-stop gradient that sweeps a target forever on an additive blend. Returns the Luau Node + attach steps.

tools.name: rive_count_up
tools.description: Number count-up (Luau) — A Node that eases a price/number 0→value each frame and writes a currency-formatted string to a bound text prop. Returns the Luau source + steps.

tools.name: rive_sheen
tools.description: Sheen light-pass — A quick diagonal white light-pass across a surface — tactile, reflective. One-shot band + timeline.

tools.name: rive_depth_shadow
tools.description: Depth shadow — A soft, background-tinted feathered shadow offset behind a card for real elevation. Never pure black.

tools.name: rive_kinetic_type
tools.description: Kinetic type — Headline group rises + overshoots into place (elastic). Animates the container, never font-size.

tools.name: rive_rect
tools.description: Rectangle primitive — Place a rectangle with fill/stroke/feather — the building block under glass cards, bars, gilds, masks.

tools.name: rive_divider
tools.description: Hairline divider — A 1–2px hairline for section separators or a gold edge-gild. Horizontal or vertical.

tools.name: rive_focus_ring
tools.description: Focus ring — A 2px accent outline at an offset around a box + a fade-in timeline to drive from a focused boolean. Never remove focus.

tools.name: rive_particle_assemble
tools.description: Particle assemble — N shard rects converge from scattered offsets into a tight cluster with an elastic settle. The high-drama hero coalesce.

tools.name: rive_state_driven_theme
tools.description: State-driven theme — Creates a Theme ViewModel of color tokens + one instance per palette. Bind fills/runs to these → re-theme everything from one source (the #1 PRO-MAX move).

themes.description: Comma-separated palette ids → one instance each

tools.name: rive_scramble_text
tools.description: Scramble text (Luau) — A Node that resolves a target string left-to-right out of random glyphs over a duration. Returns the Luau source + steps.

tools.name: rive_magnetic_hover
tools.description: Magnetic hover (Luau) — A Node that reads pointer events and writes a lerped offset to two VM numbers (springs back on exit). Bind your element x/y to them. Returns the Luau source.

tools.name: rive_parallax_depth
tools.description: Parallax depth — Creates scroll/scrollSmooth number VM props + a Luau lerp Node + an amplitude Converter so layers travel at different speeds against one scroll source.

tools.name: rive_doctor
tools.description: Check the Rive desktop bridge connection and list the open artboards.

tools.name: rive_raw_call
tools.description: Escape hatch: call a raw Rive bridge tool (e.g. animation_editor) with arbitrary arguments.

tools.name: rive_presets
tools.description: Return the PRO-MAX design tokens: named awwwards easings (cubic-bezier) and curated palettes.

tools.name: rive_docs
tools.description: Read the bundled references — design DNA, anti-generic laws, recipe catalog, the raw Rive bridge API, AND the official Rive Luau scripting docs (protocols/scaffolds, drawing API Path/Paint/Gradient/Renderer/Vec2D, data-binding, script inputs, pointer events). Call with no topic to LIST every doc; pass a slug (e.g. "scripting/protocols", "scripting/drawing-api", "design-dna", "bridge-cheatsheet") to read one. Use this BEFORE writing any Luau (holo-shimmer, count-up, custom effects).

topic.description: Doc slug, e.g. scripting/protocols. Omit to list all.
